scope: Jobs Apply/LinkedIn referrals, Recruiters action queue, Job Outreach, Active Opportunities, Hiring/Interview promotion, outcomes

canonical_authority.note: This JSON is a deterministic IMPLEMENTATION PROJECTION of existing Notion product decisions and Jim's current instruction; it does not supersede product authority or Jira delivery state.

evidence_quality.questionnaire: The original ~39-60 question-by-question transcript has NOT been fully recovered. No invented individual answers.
basis: Interview OS Oct 14 approved interaction contract
Jim current request for auto-removal of authoritative rejections

conflicts.latest: Native Notion two-table design from LIFE-47 comment 10177; actions on canonical linked records or proven private surface

conflicts.old: D194 manual Confirm Rejected even with mail evidence
conflicts.latest: Jim requests automatic removal on exact authoritative rejection

canonical_data_owners.scheduler: existing LIFE OS Daily Runs / V7 executor only

current_frontend.surface: private Daily LIFE OS Report right column
current_frontend.presentation: Notion native tables; no public HTML embed
current_frontend.action_surface: linked authenticated canonical records; no inert buttons or claims of inline actions in native simple tables

implementation_rules.when: inbound evidence describes a job
implementation_rules.then: match employer + exact role/requisition and existing identity; one row per distinct verified job
implementation_rules.guard: uncertain or competing identity => Needs Review; no guessed promotion
implementation_rules.acceptance: two distinct requisitions remain separate; repeat evidence joins same job

implementation_rules.when: display Career Hiring in private Daily Report
implementation_rules.then: two native Notion tables: Active Opportunities and Job Outreach; source-updated CT stamp; no row tint; attention order
implementation_rules.guard: never a public private-data embed or second store
implementation_rules.acceptance: both tables display complete, actual source-linked rows

implementation_rules.when: display Active Opportunities
implementation_rules.then: columns Company — Role | Stage | Next step · Due | Notes; existing Notes link
implementation_rules.guard: offer evidence not a stage change; no invented due dates
implementation_rules.acceptance: five real source-backed rows shown with 4 approved columns

implementation_rules.when: display Job Outreach
implementation_rules.then: columns Job | Outreach counts (contacted/replied/referrals confirmed) | Next follow-up | Notes (Job Ledger link)
implementation_rules.guard: no generic People directory; no cold applications
implementation_rules.acceptance: job-grouped rows with verified counts and exact Ledger links

implementation_rules.when: user selects a hiring opportunity
implementation_rules.then: navigate to existing opportunity parent, Job Ledger, Calendar invites, interview child Notes; protect manual notes
implementation_rules.guard: never invent source links or clone interview data
implementation_rules.acceptance: real Notion navigation and preserved authored content

implementation_rules.when: user needs an action
implementation_rules.then: offer working authorized actions from canonical record or proven private UI; never pretend static Notion cells are controls
implementation_rules.source: Job Ledger and hiring decision backend
implementation_rules.guard: confirmation, identity guard, durable write/read-back and visible errors
implementation_rules.acceptance: actual click/action => correct canonical state => updated table

implementation_rules.when: user reaches Apply on a Job Ledger record
implementation_rules.then: show top 3 verified relevant LinkedIn connections, optionally more, ranked for that job
implementation_rules.guard: no invented LinkedIn identity/relationship or new CRM
implementation_rules.acceptance: three verified role-relevant people for an eligible job or truthful none

implementation_rules.when: user chooses Reach Out for suggested person
implementation_rules.then: open that person's LinkedIn profile only
implementation_rules.guard: no Draft/Planned/contacted entry, no automatic send
implementation_rules.acceptance: profile opens; zero writes

implementation_rules.when: Jim actually sends and selects Mark as Sent
implementation_rules.then: create exactly one role-specific conversation; status Waiting; next follow-up in 2 business days
implementation_rules.source: Jim-confirmed action, existing Recruiters/outreach canonical record
implementation_rules.guard: must not assume an unsent message was sent; idempotent
implementation_rules.acceptance: one verified canonical row and correct due date; repeat no-op

implementation_rules.when: recruiter action is unfinished
implementation_rules.then: persist Action Status: Needs Action, Waiting, Completed, Dismissed; Follow-up Date
implementation_rules.source: existing Recruiters & Human Outreach data source
implementation_rules.guard: preserve Active, Done, Needs review, source links and human fields
implementation_rules.acceptance: schema live and exact read-back; no duplicate store

implementation_rules.when: action remains Needs Action or Waiting over a week boundary
implementation_rules.then: show it in persistent Needs Action then Waiting/Follow-up views, ordered urgency/due
implementation_rules.source: Recruiters data source, Action Status, Follow-up Date
implementation_rules.guard: remove current-week-only Week Ending >= Today suppression
implementation_rules.acceptance: prior-week unfinished item remains visible next week

implementation_rules.when: new direct recruiter/hiring-person message identifies exact job
implementation_rules.then: create one Job Outreach Needs Action item with source email deep link
implementation_rules.guard: ambiguous job => Needs Review; automation/notification alone not recruiter
implementation_rules.acceptance: direct message appears exactly once and links to source

implementation_rules.when: Jim responds or explicitly handles incoming recruiter action
implementation_rules.then: mark appropriate action Waiting; manual uninterested => Dismissed
implementation_rules.source: confirmed operator state / supported reply evidence
implementation_rules.guard: never infer a LinkedIn reply without authorized source
implementation_rules.acceptance: Waiting or Dismissed persists and read-back matches

implementation_rules.when: 2-business-day waiting deadline reached without qualifying response
implementation_rules.then: reactivate Needs Action, preserving conversation history
implementation_rules.guard: do not infer absence from incomplete mail source; no auto-send
implementation_rules.acceptance: due action reappears after week rollover

implementation_rules.when: new substantive recruiter/human reply arrives
implementation_rules.then: reactivate action and preserve original role-specific thread linkage
implementation_rules.guard: one person may have multiple distinct job conversations; do not cross-link
implementation_rules.acceptance: same job gets new next action, other job unchanged

implementation_rules.when: referral is offered
implementation_rules.then: record Referral Offered distinct from Referral Confirmed
implementation_rules.guard: offered alone never suppresses action as confirmed
implementation_rules.acceptance: status stays offered pending proof

implementation_rules.when: referral submitted/invitation proof arrives or Jim explicitly confirms evidence unavailable
implementation_rules.then: mark Referral Confirmed and stop redundant referral prompts for that job
implementation_rules.source: verified referral evidence or Jim-confirmed exception
implementation_rules.guard: retain referral history; never mark Applied automatically
implementation_rules.acceptance: confirmed count increments; redundant follow-ups cease

implementation_rules.when: recruiter row is received from a generic LinkedIn digest
implementation_rules.then: do not produce Active recruiter record unless recruiting evidence is present
implementation_rules.guard: no generic 'just messaged you' classification
implementation_rules.acceptance: unverified notification is unresolved, not an active recruiter

implementation_rules.when: genuine recruiter message includes company, role, request
implementation_rules.then: extract fixed evidence patterns, enrich same-message blank fields in place
implementation_rules.guard: preserve human-filled fields; exact source URL for enrichment
implementation_rules.acceptance: one row, correct identity, last message and idempotent

implementation_rules.when: verified interview request arrives, even before scheduled
implementation_rules.then: promote whole exact job from Job Outreach to Active Opportunities with all linked conversations
implementation_rules.guard: ambiguous requests go to Needs Review, no duplicate opportunity
implementation_rules.acceptance: same job identity moves and retains history

implementation_rules.when: interview rounds exist
implementation_rules.then: show distinct chronological interview rows with participants/time, Calendar links, Notes child links
implementation_rules.guard: protect original freeform Notes; show unknown rather than guess
implementation_rules.acceptance: each supported round navigates to actual existing source

implementation_rules.when: direct exact-authority rejection mail matches one specific active opportunity
implementation_rules.then: auto-retire only that pursuit from Active after guarded canonical update, with history/read-back; maintain reopen
implementation_rules.source: Gmail/Outlook rejection + Job Ledger or one Notes parent
implementation_rules.guard: conflict: earlier D194 required manual Confirm Rejected; Jim now requests auto-remove for authoritative exact rejections; ambiguous or conflicting evidence remains review-only
implementation_rules.acceptance: same exact rejected job vanishes on next projection, recruiter follow-up survives; no other job changes

implementation_rules.when: rejection evidence is possible/company-only/ambiguous
implementation_rules.then: show Needs Review and a working Confirm Rejected action, no automatic close
implementation_rules.guard: human confirmation explicitly required for ambiguous evidence
implementation_rules.acceptance: confirmation writes guarded rejection, exact read-back, removes only target

implementation_rules.when: operator reverses previously confirmed closure
implementation_rules.then: Reopen same exact pursuit and retain audit/history
implementation_rules.guard: idempotent, no duplicate or lost interview child
implementation_rules.acceptance: row reappears and history remains

implementation_rules.when: offer email arrives
implementation_rules.then: surface Offer Review; remain in Active until explicit human outcome
implementation_rules.guard: offer is not a rejection, accepted offer or automatic stage change
implementation_rules.acceptance: offer action and source link visible without silent closure

implementation_rules.when: no direct human update for 7 calendar days after last qualifying contact or past interview
implementation_rules.then: show Stale as reversible attention state, not rejection or deletion
implementation_rules.guard: verified future interview protects from Stale until it passes
implementation_rules.acceptance: fresh source resets timer; no silent closure

implementation_rules.when: applied job aged 30 days
implementation_rules.then: retain if human recruiter/interview/hiring progression exists; purge only unprotected stale jobs under accepted retention contract
implementation_rules.source: Job Ledger and canonical acquisition lifecycle
implementation_rules.guard: absence of source or failed poll never proves closure
implementation_rules.acceptance: active pursuits survive 30-day rule; unprotected ones follow lifecycle suppression rule

implementation_rules.when: any source read, write, identity or read-back is incomplete
implementation_rules.then: DEGRADED or Needs Review, keep last accepted state, do not invent positive facts
implementation_rules.guard: no silent paid tools, TinyFish, public secrets, second scheduler/datastore
implementation_rules.acceptance: forced failure makes no destructive mutation and visibly exposes problem

mandatory: Validate each rule's input/condition/action and negative control
Prove Notion frontend renders both tables with authoritative live data and no week-based hiding
Click each working action at real private destination and verify exact canonical read-back
Verify SH/FT-like exact rejection affects only that job and keeps recruiter follow-up
Verify job-ledger LinkedIn top-three; Reach Out is no-write; Mark as Sent creates exactly one Waiting record
Verify 2-business-day recruiter follow-ups survive week boundaries
Prove identity ambiguity and incomplete source fail closed
Preserve unrelated Notion Daily Report regions with digest/read-back
Jira issues remain open until Jim accepts full user outcome

delivery_issues.LIFE-20: Recruiters queue schema and persistent views; To Do
delivery_issues.LIFE-47: Native recruiting/hiring UI and integrations; In Progress

flowchart_mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Job application or direct recruiter message] --> B{Verified job and person identity?}
 B -->|No| REVIEW[Needs Review - no guessed writes]
 B -->|Yes| C{Interview requested?}
 C -->|Yes, even unscheduled| ACTIVE[Active Opportunities table]
 C -->|No, human engagement| OUTREACH[Job Outreach table]
 C -->|No human engagement| LEDGER[Job Ledger only]
 LEDGER --> APPLY[Apply: show top 3 verified LinkedIn connections]
 APPLY --> REACH[Reach Out: open profile, no write]
 REACH --> SENT{Jim marks Sent?}
 SENT -->|No| APPLY
 SENT -->|Yes| WAIT[Track exact job contact - Waiting - 2 business days]
 WAIT --> OUTREACH
 OUTREACH --> INBOUND[Incoming role-specific email: Needs Action and source link]
 INBOUND --> REPLY{Handled / replied?}
 REPLY -->|Replied| WAIT
 REPLY -->|Dismissed| HIST[Preserve historical record]
 REPLY -->|Interview requested| ACTIVE
 WAIT --> REF{Verified referral?}
 REF -->|Offered only| WAIT
 REF -->|Confirmed with evidence| SUPPRESS[Stop redundant referral reminders, preserve proof]
 SUPPRESS --> OUTREACH
 OUTREACH --> TIME{Follow-up due?}
 TIME -->|Yes| ACTION[Needs Action, not hidden by week]
 TIME -->|No| OUTREACH
 ACTION --> OUTREACH
 ACTIVE --> DETAIL[Open Notes, Ledger, Calendar, interview child]
 ACTIVE --> RESULT{Hiring outcome evidence?}
 RESULT -->|Offer| OFFER[Offer review; remain Active]
 RESULT -->|Ambiguous| REVIEW
 RESULT -->|Exact authoritative rejection| CLOSE[Retire exact pursuit; verify; retain history and reopen]
 CLOSE --> RETIRED[Retired Opportunities; keep recruiter relationship]
 RETIRED --> REOPEN{Jim reopens?}
 REOPEN -->|Yes| ACTIVE
